'''Lorax Fitzgerald The Eliminator''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Lorax Fitzgerald]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-6816">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/6816 The Eliminator], DeckTech (Lorax "Lorax" Fitzgerald, 17 May 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/6816/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/6816/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018170729/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/6816/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Lorax Fitzgerald]]
* '''Published:''' 17 May 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''The Eliminator''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif|label=Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor HD Fitzgerald DS 2000 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' With strong characters, tracked destiny, and the right red cards...this can be a tough deck to deal with.

== Original post ==

'''The Eliminator'''
* '''Author:''' Lorax "Lorax" Fitzgerald
* '''Published:''' May 17, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' With strong characters, tracked destiny, and the right red cards...this can be a tough deck to deal with.

=== Strategy ===

Strategy Set up - start draining and you gotta win the battles.

Use the dark path/set for stun, to set up a leathal combination. This essentially stops the benefit from MWYHL decks.

Hidden Base...if you get jabba, cruiser, and pilot in space with security up, just probe kessel and block that drain

ops - go right to their plant, stun the op and beat up on the speeder.
